# agent-tools

> A structured autonomous agent execution system for GitHub Copilot and coding agents. Provides a plan-first, milestone-based execution framework with enforced code practices, safety governance, and on-demand specialist skills.

This toolkit is designed to be copied into any repository's `.github/` folder. Once in place, agents follow a deterministic boot sequence that enforces planning before execution, safety checks, playbook-driven implementation, and skill loading.

## System Instructions

- [AGENTS.md](.github/AGENTS.md): Primary entry point for autonomous agents — boot sequence, directory map, core rules
- [copilot-instructions.md](.github/copilot-instructions.md): GitHub Copilot bootstrap — same boot sequence, skills and playbooks reference

## Planning Framework

- [agent-planning-framework.md](.github/instructions/agent-planning-framework.md): Core planning rules, plan file location, authority rules
- [agent-execution-protocol.md](.github/instructions/agent-execution-protocol.md): Milestone execution loop, failure recovery, resume protocol
- [agent-plan-generation.md](.github/instructions/agent-plan-generation.md): Pipeline for generating valid plans with playbooks pre-applied
- [agent-playbook-selection.md](.github/instructions/agent-playbook-selection.md): Auto-detection rules for which playbooks apply to a task
- [taskplan_TEMPLATE.md](.github/plan/taskplan_TEMPLATE.md): Template for all plan files

## Code & Safety Standards

- [agent-code-practices-framework.md](.github/instructions/agent-code-practices-framework.md): Mandatory coding standards enforced across all agent-generated code
- [agent-safety.instructions.md](.github/instructions/agent-safety.instructions.md): Safety and governance rules for AI agent systems
- [agent-skills.instructions.md](.github/instructions/agent-skills.instructions.md): Guidelines for creating and structuring SKILL.md files

## Language Instructions

- [python.instructions.md](.github/instructions/python.instructions.md): Idiomatic Python standards (PEP 8, type hints, error handling, testing)
- [typescript.instructions.md](.github/instructions/typescript.instructions.md): Idiomatic TypeScript/JavaScript standards (strict mode, naming, async, React)
- [go.instructions.md](.github/instructions/go.instructions.md): Idiomatic Go standards (Effective Go, naming, error handling, formatting)
- [csharp.instructions.md](.github/instructions/csharp.instructions.md): Idiomatic C# standards (Unity/Godot, nullable refs, memory, async, NUnit)
- [cpp.instructions.md](.github/instructions/cpp.instructions.md): Modern C++ standards (C++17/20, Unreal Engine, RAII, GC rules, clang-format)
- [swift.instructions.md](.github/instructions/swift.instructions.md): Idiomatic Swift standards (SwiftUI, async/await, ARC, adaptive layouts, XCTest)
- [kotlin.instructions.md](.github/instructions/kotlin.instructions.md): Idiomatic Kotlin/Android standards (Jetpack Compose, coroutines, Flow, WindowSizeClass)
- [context-engineering.instructions.md](.github/instructions/context-engineering.instructions.md): Structuring code for better Copilot context and suggestions
- [ai-prompt-engineering-safety-best-practices.instructions.md](.github/instructions/ai-prompt-engineering-safety-best-practices.instructions.md): Prompt safety, bias mitigation, and responsible AI usage

## Playbooks

- [api-development.playbook.md](.github/playbooks/api-development.playbook.md): RESTful API implementation — contract-first, validation, error handling
- [testing.playbook.md](.github/playbooks/testing.playbook.md): Test pyramid, AAA structure, coverage minimums, isolation rules
- [debugging.playbook.md](.github/playbooks/debugging.playbook.md): Systematic defect isolation and fix verification
- [refactoring.playbook.md](.github/playbooks/refactoring.playbook.md): Behaviour-preserving code improvement
- [accessibility-compliance.playbook.md](.github/playbooks/accessibility-compliance.playbook.md): UI/UX accessibility and compliance implementation
- [performance.playbook.md](.github/playbooks/performance.playbook.md): Measure-first performance optimization workflow
- [game-development.playbook.md](.github/playbooks/game-development.playbook.md): Core loop first, vertical slice, playtest loop, scope management
- [game-testing.playbook.md](.github/playbooks/game-testing.playbook.md): Automated game logic tests, structured playtest sessions, platform certification
- [mobile-development.playbook.md](.github/playbooks/mobile-development.playbook.md): Design for smallest screen first, adaptive layout rules, App Store / Play Store submission checklist
- [monorepo-workflow.playbook.md](.github/playbooks/monorepo-workflow.playbook.md): Single-repo structure for web + mobile + backend — pnpm workspaces, Turborepo, affected-only CI, coordinated releases

## Scripts

- [generate-plan.ts](.github/scripts/generate-plan.ts): Scaffolds a new plan file from the template. Run: `npx ts-node .github/scripts/generate-plan.ts "<task name>"`
- [plan-validate.ts](.github/scripts/plan-validate.ts): Validates a plan file has all required sections and no unfilled placeholders. Run: `npx ts-node .github/scripts/plan-validate.ts .github/plan/<task>.plan.md`
- [plan-checksum.ts](.github/scripts/plan-checksum.ts): Computes a SHA-256 hash of milestone statuses for drift detection. Run: `npx ts-node .github/scripts/plan-checksum.ts .github/plan/<task>.plan.md`
- [plan-sync.ts](.github/scripts/plan-sync.ts): Verifies every skill, playbook, and instruction is referenced in AGENTS.md and copilot-instructions.md. Run: `npx ts-node .github/scripts/plan-sync.ts`

## Skills

On-demand specialist capabilities. Each skill's `SKILL.md` defines when it should be loaded.

- [acquire-codebase-knowledge](.github/skills/acquire-codebase-knowledge/SKILL.md): Map, document, and onboard into an existing codebase
- [agent-governance](.github/skills/agent-governance/SKILL.md): Add governance, safety, and trust controls to AI agent systems
- [agent-owasp-compliance](.github/skills/agent-owasp-compliance/SKILL.md): Check agent codebases against OWASP ASI Top 10
- [security-review](.github/skills/security-review/SKILL.md): AI-powered codebase security scanner
- [secret-scanning](.github/skills/secret-scanning/SKILL.md): GitHub secret scanning configuration and remediation
- [create-readme](.github/skills/create-readme/SKILL.md): Generate a comprehensive README.md
- [create-specification](.github/skills/create-specification/SKILL.md): Create a specification file optimized for AI consumption
- [create-llms](.github/skills/create-llms/SKILL.md): Generate an llms.txt file for a repository

### Game Development

- [game-architecture](.github/skills/game-architecture/SKILL.md): Engine-agnostic game patterns — ECS, game loop, FSM, object pooling, event bus, save/load
- [unity-game-builder](.github/skills/unity-game-builder/SKILL.md): Unity-specific patterns — MonoBehaviour lifecycle, ScriptableObjects, Input System, pooling, Addressables
- [unreal-game-builder](.github/skills/unreal-game-builder/SKILL.md): Unreal Engine patterns — UObject hierarchy, macros, C++ vs Blueprint, delegates, subsystems, GC
- [game-design-patterns](.github/skills/game-design-patterns/SKILL.md): Game feel, difficulty curves, player guidance, economy design, onboarding anti-patterns

### Mobile

- [ios-app-builder](.github/skills/ios-app-builder/SKILL.md): iOS/iPadOS patterns — SwiftUI, NavigationSplitView, adaptive layouts, Core Data, Keychain, App Store submission
- [android-app-builder](.github/skills/android-app-builder/SKILL.md): Android patterns — Jetpack Compose, ViewModel, WindowSizeClass, Room, WorkManager, Play Store submission
- [mobile-app-architecture](.github/skills/mobile-app-architecture/SKILL.md): Cross-platform mobile architecture — MVVM, offline-first, adaptive navigation (phone vs tablet), deep linking, push notifications

### Web & Full-stack

- [web-app-builder](.github/skills/web-app-builder/SKILL.md): React/Next.js patterns — App Router, SSR/SSG/CSR, TanStack Query, Zustand, responsive layout, auth, performance checklist
- [fullstack-cross-platform](.github/skills/fullstack-cross-platform/SKILL.md): Keeping web, Android, and iOS in sync — OpenAPI contract, design tokens, feature flags, API versioning, environment config per platform
- [documentation-writer](.github/skills/documentation-writer/SKILL.md): Diataxis-based technical documentation expert
- [go-mcp-server-generator](.github/skills/go-mcp-server-generator/SKILL.md): Generate a complete Go MCP server project
- [azure-architecture-autopilot](.github/skills/azure-architecture-autopilot/SKILL.md): Design or analyze Azure infrastructure with diagrams

## Optional

- [mcp-security-audit](.github/skills/mcp-security-audit/SKILL.md): Audit MCP server configurations for security issues
- [gdpr-compliant](.github/skills/gdpr-compliant/SKILL.md): Apply GDPR-compliant engineering practices
- [az-cost-optimize](.github/skills/az-cost-optimize/SKILL.md): Analyze and optimize Azure resource costs
